security_spec.violation_condition: XiangShan pipeline commits ssp decrement before the shadow stack store is guaranteed architecturally complete (e.g., store still in store queue, or store issued speculatively past an unresolved branch/exception), and a trap, interrupt, or store fault subsequently occurs. The ssp is architecturally visible via CSR read while the corresponding shadow stack memory location still holds stale/unwritten data, violating the requirement that ssp shall decrement only when the store will complete successfully.
security_spec.summary: PR #2782 relaxes ssp-update-to-store ordering: hardware may update ssp speculatively before the shadow stack store is architecturally resolved, risking ssp corruption on fault/trap if the store ultimately fails
